description: When is the next US jobs report (Employment Situation: nonfarm payrolls and the unemployment rate)? Returns the next release date and time in US Eastern, UTC and your time zone (London by default), its reference month, and the following scheduled dates (up to 12). Source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics Employment Situation schedule page. Gives dates only, not the payroll figures; does not cover the ADP private payrolls report or weekly jobless claims (Department of Labor). (cost: 1 credit)

timezone.description: string, optional, IANA time zone for the local time fields (e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo), default Europe/London

name: next_jobs_report_release
